questions.question: Who is the current CEO of Aether Labs?
questions.ground_truth: Raj Patel became CEO of Aether Labs on 2025-01-06, succeeding Maya Chen

questions.question: What core product does NovaGraph develop?
questions.ground_truth: NovaGraph distributed graph query engine for real-time analytics

questions.question: Who led the Series B funding round for Aether Labs?
questions.ground_truth: Rivermoor Capital led the $25M Series B funding round for Aether Labs

questions.question: Which company acquired PulseDB, the startup co-founded by Hiro Tanaka?
Who is the tech lead for NovaGraph and what startup did he previously co-found?
questions.ground_truth: Hiro Tanaka, co-founder of Aether Labs and tech lead for NovaGraph, previously co-founded PulseDB

questions.question: List key executive and leadership names mentioned across Aether Labs and PulseDB.
questions.ground_truth: Raj Patel (CEO), Maya Chen (former CEO), Hiro Tanaka (co-founder / tech lead), Lena Okonkwo (Head of Temporal Systems)

questions.question: List the main companies, startups, and investor organizations in the corpus.
questions.ground_truth: Aether Labs, PulseDB, NovaGraph, Rivermoor Capital, GraphWeekly

questions.question: What was PulseDB's reported revenue in 2023 versus the 2025 audited figure?
questions.ground_truth: Reported as $12 million in 2023 internal docs, but superseded by $8.5 million in the 2025 Reuters audited report

questions.question: Who was the CEO of Aether Labs in 2023 versus 2025?
questions.ground_truth: Maya Chen was CEO in 2023, superseded by Raj Patel who became CEO in January 2025
